observations: High-back executive office chair in brown upholstery.
Features an integrated, extendable footrest under the seat.
Armrests have chrome-colored trim and padded tops.
The side panels of the chair feature a diamond-stitched pattern.
Five-star base with casters; the base and wheels appear to be wrapped in protective plastic.
The chair is positioned in a showroom or warehouse environment alongside other office furniture.
A yellow tag is visible on the headrest, but the text is unreadable.
Watermark on the image reads 'AMAZING CHILUV CONCEPT'.

claims.evidence: The term 'premium' is a subjective marketing descriptor.
Comfort and elegance are subjective qualities that cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be low-durability faux leather (PU/PVC) rather than genuine leather.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the material grain and a shot of the fabric backing at a seam.

risks.risk: The gas lift or reclining mechanism may be non-functional or weak.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair height being adjusted and the back reclining under weight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a faulty mechanism

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage or tears on the back or non-visible side.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear and the left side of the chair.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having minor cosmetic or structural defects

proof_requests: Video demonstrating the gas lift and reclining functions.
Close-up photo of the upholstery to determine material quality.
Photos of the back of the chair and the underside of the seat.
response.reason: The item is a standard executive office chair with a footrest. While mechanical condition and material are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case functional state for this specific type of furniture.
